path: A path that skips the pool fallback
focus.substep: Probe the pool member on igPool rather than counting failures downstream
focus.why: The whole failure is traced: a null pool yields a null allocation, element addresses computed from that null base become small integers used as pointers, and an ordinary flag write four bytes into one corrupts the memory-context global. Every instruction involved was checked against the retail game and translates correctly. Retail reaches the same allocation with a real pool; activate resolves one successfully 16 times out of 17, so one path is skipping that fallback.
